description_expanded: ABOUT SEACREST 6: Seacrest Townhome #6 is a beautiful, two story townhome that sits directly on the gulf. Each floor has a porch facing the gulf for that relaxing cup of coffee, watching the sunrise in the morning and that romantic sunset at night. The first floor has a fully equipped kitchen and a spacious living room with a sleeper sofa. While relaxing in the living room or cooking in the kitchen, open the curtains and you will have a spectacular view of the white sandy beaches and turquoise water. The second floor has a King size bed in one bedroom that overlooks 30A, while the other has a King bed and a porch overlooking the beautiful ocean. Seacrest Townhome is along 30A and tucked between Rosemary Beach and Seaside, which means that you have the luxury of walking or riding your bike to any of the charming shopping centers. You can relax on our gorgeous white sandy beaches during the day and enjoy the nightlife and shopping in the evening. BEACH ACCESS: * Direct access from the property * 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella included March - October PARKING: * Parking for 1 vehicle * 2 Bikes Included PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. *Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to the properties we manage may go under construction without being notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
Outdoor Features: Beach Chair Service | 2 Chairs & 1 Umbrella | Mar 1 - Oct 31
